"templateId": "71eec55c-f686-508e-ba44-bc8e4b4a4636",
"title": "Request mortgage documents",
"text": "Subject: Mortgage document request for planning review\n\nHello Alina Wrenpuddle,\n\nWe are updating the planning file for Alina Wrenpuddle and would appreciate copies of the mortgage materials listed below, if available:\n- Most recent mortgage statement\n- Current interest rate, payment amount, escrow amount, and maturity information\n- Loan estimate or closing disclosure, if this is a new or pending mortgage\n- Refinance proposal or payoff quote, if applicable\n- Property tax and homeowners insurance details, if not shown on the statement\n\nPlease upload documents through [SECURE UPLOAD METHOD] or let us know the best secure delivery method. If any item is unavailable, a brief note with the current figures is still helpful.\n\nThank you,\n[TEAM MEMBER NAME]\nPocket Lantern Advisory\n\nWe need the Boulder closing disclosure, the first full mortgage statement for the new Boulder home, and a current statement for the Portland condo now used as a rental.",

"evidence": "By 2025-08-29, the agreed follow-up is to collect the Boulder closing disclosure, the first full mortgage statement for the new home, and a current statement for the Portland condo after its conversion to rental use, because those items are missing from the planning file."
},
